_metadata.description: Amazon Fulfillment Center codes mapped to US states. Covers FCs, sort centers, and delivery stations (S-prefix). Amazon opens/closes facilities regularly — keep updated.
_metadata.source: Public records, seller community data, SP-API inventory ledger. Verify with Amazon if critical.
how_to_add_unknown_codes: When `inventory-health` reports an unmapped FC code:
1. Find the STATE from the facility's street address. Seller Central >
Inventory > Shipments shows the destination address; public FC address
lists also work. Verify the ZIP matches the state — directory lists do
contain typos (SYS3 was published as 'NC' with a Tennessee ZIP).
2. NEVER infer a state from the letters in the code. XMD5 is in PENNSYLVANIA,
not Maryland; XCH2 is in GEORGIA, not Chicago. The S-prefix is likewise
inconsistent here: SAZ/SCA/SCO encode states, but SAT/SBD/SBN/SCK are
airport codes. A wrong FC->state mapping fabricates nexus evidence for a
registration decision — prefer leaving a code unmapped.
at parse time, so stored rows are NOT fixed by editing this file alone)
4. Record the evidence for medium-confidence codes in evidence_notes below.
